post.description: Pull new jobs from the marketplace into this user's inbox (what the worker does on schedule).

Resume the interrupted graph with the human's decision. Approve submits (idempotently),
edit re-checks compliance and may interrupt again, reject ends the thread.

Rewrite one paragraph of the pending draft with the writer model, keeping citations to known
evidence only. The result is returned for the editor; the user still approves or edits.

Run the conversation graph for this thread: classify the latest client message, draft a reply,
and stop for approval.
Pull marketplace events and proposal statuses; move cards; feed outcome memory.

X3 Portfolio builder: turn repositories into case studies verified against their code.
source=github reads the user's account through the official GitHub MCP server (read-only);
source=demo reads a demo persona's repositories from disk, so the feature works without a token.
Drafts stop at an approval; only approved case studies are added to the user's own portfolio.
Time travel: fork a new thread from a checkpoint of this run and continue from there.
